name: AI ROI Ledger – Alerts and monthly report

nodes.name: Ledger webhook
nodes.notes: Copy the Production URL into the ledger: Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook.

nodes.name: Compute HMAC
nodes.notes: Paste the signing secret shown once when you created the webhook. The ledger signs the exact JSON it sends; re-serialising the parsed body reproduces it. TODO: if your n8n version re-orders keys, enable the Webhook's Raw Body option and hash the raw body instead.

nodes.name: Email alert / monthly summary
nodes.notes: Needs an SMTP credential. Set To: the person who should get alerts and the monthly summary.

nodes.name: Slack (optional)
nodes.notes: Optional: enable, add a Slack credential and pick the channel.
